name: Monotonic co-VC Dimension of Trivial Concepts
proof: For $n=1$, the class is the full one-dimensional cube, with ordinary coVC zero, but either one-concept subfamily has coVC one. The ambient domain bounds every hollow star by one, so the envelope is one. For $n\ge2$, the two constant concepts themselves have coVC two. Every subfamily has at most two concepts, while a hollow star of size greater than two would require more than two distinct realized neighbours. Hence the envelope is two.
